title: Mochizuki Honami — Discovering The Joys Of Drumming〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Everyone's so motivated.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Having Mr. Shindo find a studio where we can practice for an extended period was definitely the right call.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We can focus on practicing without having to worry about how much time we have left...!)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Writing this song is obviously important, but please also make sure to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Don't forget that you need to start preparing for Jam Fest soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika and Saki put an inordinate amount of effort into our debut song.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (While they worked on that, Shiho spent hours and hours practicing with me as the rhythm section...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That means I...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (As the leader of Leo/need and the drummer, I have to pull everyone in the right direction...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... That was a pretty good run.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that felt super easy...!
You did a great job of leading us, Hona♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. I hope you'll do the same thing for our other songs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's the plan!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness! I was able to lead them properly...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Then, next...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, wanna do another run while we still have this feeling fresh in our heads?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sure.
Count us in, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand why you're all so motivated, but I think it's about time for a break.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? But I can still... Wait, what?!
We've already been at it for three hours?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had a feeling that none of you had noticed...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Not only is it my job to lead us, it's also my responsibility to tell us when to stop.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I bought lunch for all of you.
Why don't you take a break...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ah, are you already taking one...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, we just decided to take one.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Then, perfect.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Knowing all of you, I had a feeling that you'd be intensely focused on practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And it seems that I wasn't entirely wrong...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
You showed excellent leadership.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! I know that this is also an important part of my job.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You've also improved quite a lot as performers.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That's of course a result of all the hard work you've been putting in each day.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You in particular, Ms. Mochizuki.
I feel that the sound you produce on the drums has changed somewhat.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's like you're doing your absolute best for your bandmates.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I believe your strong will and dedication to this band have allowed the sound you produce on the drums to evolve.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Strong will and dedication...
That does sum you up pretty well, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, is that why we were able to play really well just now?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I certainly hope so.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Oh, please take your lunches before I forget about them. I bought a few different types for you all to share...

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika, Shiho & Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They're all different.
Any preferences?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The early bird gets the worm.
I'm thinking the box of ginger fried pork.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! That's the one I want!
Hona, don't let Shiho steal it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, how about rock paper scissors?
Would that be okay with you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't just have it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When pigs fly♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha♪
